universal_lens: Sparse observability ⊗ temporal validity ⊗ state-transition under salary lag forms a triadic operator algebra where detection limits, staleness filters, and pivot valuations compose via Bayesian updating with conformal coverage guarantees.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats each primitive as a conformal predictor: observability threshold yields prediction sets for unobserved posts; temporal kernel outputs p-values for content freshness; injury-state operator maps designations to pivot distributions with finite-sample coverage; salary lag quantifies mispricing persistence.
gse_mapping: GSE executes state transitions: observability gate controls signal ingestion; temporal kernel gates corpus inclusion; injury operator triggers pivot substitution with salary-lag correction; all transitions emit telemetry for conformal recalibration and leakage veto.

primitives.name: Sparse Indexing Observability Threshold
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Constraint note (read-only indexing):** search indexing of X posts is sparse.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \eta: dimensionless detection probability; \text{posted}: binary latent state; \text{observed}: binary measurement
primitives.assumptions: Indexing process is memoryless and account-invariant; false positive rate negligible; posts arrive as Poisson process with rate \lambda
primitives.breakdown_regime: \eta \to 0 (complete observability collapse) or \eta \to 1 (full observability) — both violate sparse indexing premise

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to censored Poisson observation model in survival analysis; maps to GSE signal ingestion gate where \eta calibrates conformal prediction set width for unobserved accounts
layer2.telemetry: Empirical \hat{\eta} via capture-recapture on accounts with known posting frequency; coverage rate of 90% prediction sets for latent post counts

primitives.name: Staleness Detection Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **@SumerSports:** the SumerSports "Weekend Preview - Week 2" page (sumersports.com/the-zone/weekend-preview-week-2/) surfaced, but its content references a Thursday-night Eagles 34-28 win over the Vikings and D'Andre Swift rushing — i.e., stale prior-season material (2023), NOT Week 2 of 2026.
primitives.latex: K_{\text{temp}}(t_{\text{content}}, t_{\text{now}}) = \exp\left(-\frac{(t_{\text{now}} - t_{\text{content}})^2}{2\sigma^2}\right) \cdot \mathbb{I}[\text{entities match current season}]
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: t: timestamp [days]; \sigma: staleness bandwidth [days]; \mathbb{I}: indicator [dimensionless]; K_{\text{temp}}: validity score [0,1]
primitives.assumptions: Content timestamps are reliable; entity references (teams, players) are extractable; staleness decays quadratically; season mismatch is binary disqualifier
primitives.breakdown_regime: \sigma \to \infty (no temporal discrimination) or entity extraction fails (false freshness)

layer2.mapping: Derives from Gaussian process temporal kernel; maps to GSE corpus gate where K_{\text{temp}} < \tau triggers exclusion; \tau calibrated via conformal quantile on historical staleness labels
layer2.telemetry: False inclusion rate of stale content; AUC of staleness classifier; conformal coverage of validity threshold

primitives.name: Injury Designation to Pivot Transition Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Method:** `browser.search` with sports/news verticals and since-filters, then `browser.open` only on tool-returned URLs.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \mathcal{D} = \{\text{OUT, DOUBTFUL, QUESTIONABLE, PROBABLE}\}: designation [categorical]; \mathcal{S} = \{\text{DNP, LP, FP}\}: practice status [categorical]; \mathcal{P}: pivot player set; \Delta: probability simplex
primitives.assumptions: Designation and practice status are sufficient statistics; pivot role is binary (primary/backup); team reports are truthful; no hidden setbacks
primitives.breakdown_regime: Late-breaking news after sweep cutoff; misreported designations; multiple simultaneous injuries at same position

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to hidden Markov model with emission probabilities from injury reports; maps to GSE state-transition engine where T triggers pivot substitution with salary-lag correction
layer2.telemetry: Pivot activation rate vs. designation; fantasy points differential (pivot vs. starter); conformal coverage of pivot projection intervals

primitives.name: Salary Adjustment Lag Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Method:** `browser.search` with sports/news verticals and since-filters, then `browser.open` only on tool-returned URLs.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S: salary [$]; \Delta t: time since role change [days]; \kappa: adjustment speed [day^{-1}]; L: lag fraction [0,1]
primitives.assumptions: Salary adjustment follows first-order kinetics; fair salary S_{\text{fair}} is identifiable; no concurrent salary changes; baseline salary known

layer2.mapping: Derives from exponential relaxation model; maps to GSE value engine where L > \lambda triggers mispricing alert; \lambda calibrated via conformal quantile on historical adjustment trajectories
layer2.telemetry: Empirical \hat{\kappa} from historical pivot salary adjustments; mispricing duration distribution; ROI of lag-exploiting lineups

reasoning_traces.think:
The four primitives form a closed operator algebra for DFS intelligence under sparse observability. Observability threshold (η) governs signal ingestion: when η is low, the conformal prediction set for latent posts widens, increasing epistemic uncertainty. Temporal validity kernel (K_temp) gates corpus inclusion, preventing stale 2023 content from contaminating 2026 projections — its Gaussian bandwidth σ trades off false exclusion of fresh content against false inclusion of stale content. Injury-state transition (T) maps discrete designations to pivot distributions; its sufficiency assumption fails when late-breaking news arrives post-sweep, creating a retrocausal leakage path. Salary adjustment lag (L) quantifies the exploitable mispricing window; its exponential relaxation assumes efficient markets with friction κ. Dualities emerge: η and σ both control Type I/II errors in signal detection; T and L compose as T → pivot → L → mispricing signal. Failure modes couple: low η delays injury news detection, widening T's output distribution; stale content (low K_temp) biases S_fair estimation, corrupting L. The system achieves conformal coverage only when all four telemetry streams jointly satisfy coverage constraints.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: Observability threshold descends from capture-recapture ecology (Lincoln-Petersen, 1896) and censored Poisson processes (Survival analysis, 1970s). Temporal kernel derives from Gaussian process regression (Rasmussen & Williams, 2006) and conformal prediction (Vovk et al., 2005). Injury-state transition inherits from hidden Markov models in sports analytics (Thomas et al., 2013). Salary lag originates in market microstructure (Kyle, 1985) and exponential relaxation in econophysics (Mantegna & Stanley, 2000).
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: Opposing agents: DFS field prices pivots reactively (slow κ); injury reporters may strategically obscure (lower η); content farms recycle stale material (low K_temp). Our operator algebra models their limitations: field's κ is estimable from historical adjustments; reporters' η is measurable via capture-recapture; content farms' staleness is detectable via entity-season mismatch. We exploit the field's slow κ before their Bayesian updates incorporate pivot news.

Salary lag L must not use pivot projections from T that already incorporate salary info (temporal ordering). Conformal coverage requires independent calibration splits for each primitive's telemetry.
